name: claude-cache-watcher
displayName: Claude Code Cache and Cost Watcher
description: Real-time native status bar monitor tracking accurate Claude Code context fill rates and token pricing.

enumDescriptions: Pro / Max / Team — flat monthly fee. Costs shown are API-equivalent; tooltip shows your savings vs API rates.
API key (pay-as-you-go) — costs shown are real charges.

claudeWatcher.monthlyBudget.description: Your monthly plan cost in USD (e.g. 20 for Pro, 100 for Max). Used to calculate savings vs API rates. Only relevant for subscription plan type.

claudeWatcher.sessionBudgetUSD.description: Optional max spend per 5-hour session in USD (0 = disabled). When set, the Usage section shows a % fill and warns when you approach the limit.

claudeWatcher.weeklyBudgetUSD.description: Optional max spend per week in USD (0 = disabled). When set, the Usage section shows a % fill and warns when you approach the limit.
